name: compare
title: Image Compare Slider
description: Two images are layered, with the top one clipped to a moving handle. Moving the pointer, or dragging the divider, shifts the seam so the second picture shows through.
use: A retouch, renovation or product change needs a direct before-and-after comparison.
avoid: Hover mode snaps back to the middle on leave, so it cannot hold a position without switching to drag mode.
a11y: The slider is pointer-only with no focusable control, though both images do carry alt text. (keyboard: no, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded square frame holds one photo on the left and a pale, blurred second image on the right. A thin vertical line with a small white grip splits them, tinted indigo near the seam.
behaves: On hover the divider follows the pointer across the frame, showing more of one picture or the other. Leaving resets the seam to the middle; in drag mode it stays where released.
customise: Images, alt text, slideMode, initial percentage, autoplay timing and custom first/second/handle content are props; divider colours are baked into classes.
weight: light: A clip-path update per pointer move, plus a small decorative star field near the line.
